name: Wix
tagline: A website builder with an AI that creates a complete site from a short conversation.
about: Wix is a website platform for small businesses. Its AI builder asks a few questions and produces a full site with text and images, which you then edit.
pros: AI builds a full site from a few answers.
Hosting, bookings and online store tools are included.
cons: Free sites show Wix ads and use a Wix address.
Hard to move a site to another platform later.
